framing: u32 little-endian payload byte length, strict UTF-8 JSON, no envelope

candidates.provider_id: codex or claude or hermes or pi

notes: All request fields are exact; reject unknown and duplicate keys. A connection is bound at hello.
Unknown/pending or budget-limited snapshots may have coverage status only; all snapshot top-level fields remain present.
No title outside explicit choices, no raw cwd/argv/image path in ordinary snapshots. Explicit candidates disclose only bounded registered installation locators to local settings.
Snapshot status available only means sampler available. Instance status available only means verified process alive.

After scope commit, until the sampler publishes the new revision: full top-level snapshot, status unknown/reason scope_pending, current scope_revision, old sampling seq permitted, no instances/resources/grants. Never relabel old directory IDs. Repeated equal seq is permitted for the same cached sampling interval; seq cannot decrease within a generation.
No model/private source is queried. Session/pending remain unknown. CPU first sample and unreadable metrics are null.
Grant IDs are reused until expiry. seq in return is issued_seq, not latest snapshot seq.
Disconnect revokes that connection grants and staging. Scope commit revokes all grants. No action replay on reconnect.

scope_hash is SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON roots with ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, separators comma/colon. Roots fields are directory_id,path in that order. Rust streams the same serialization into SHA256 and validates commit, without allocating another full scope buffer.
read/write each have a whole-frame deadline; idle readers must not be confused with partial-frame retries.
Protocol v2 does not change profile_key/profile/v1 or named-pipe identity domains.

Observations exact keys revision,registrations; normalize registrations sorted by id, recursively sorted JSON keys, UTF-8, no spaces/ascii escaping/slash escaping. revision0 allowed only for empty legacy state; v3 persistent revision starts1.

Configuration revision/hash differ from scope_revision. Sync registrations CAS on base pair; same target pair idempotent. ACK is receipt, not installation verification. Every sample carries its actual config pair. Pending full snapshot has empty registrations/instances/resources and current application pair.

category builtin uses fixed provider codex/claude/hermes/pi and compatible npm_command/hermes_launcher/codex_desktop; custom_exe uses null provider, executable locator. Windows local only; enabled bool; binding_state confirmed/rebind_required.

registration status: available/limited/not_found/not_configured/unknown; duplicate_of_id null except duplicate_installation. Instance classification provider/custom_exe; custom provider_id null, kind custom_exe, session/pending unknown. Unique process/resource regardless of registration references.

Default observed-instance/console returns limited, action_id null; first registration slice issues only verified registered GUI manual_navigation grants. Config commit revokes all grants; returns require exact current config pair.
Candidate query explicit only, existing catalog no additional scan; 64 rows/64KiB, no title/argv. Unavailable source does not prevent saving registration intent.
profile_key_encoding: SHA256(ASCII session-panel-observer/profile/v1 + NUL + uint32LE raw SID length + raw binary SID + uint64LE FILE_ID_INFO.VolumeSerialNumber + FILE_ID_128.Identifier[16])
peer_credentials: GetNamedPipeServerProcessId/client process ID plus held process handle, exact creation FILETIME, TOKEN_USER raw SID, TOKEN_STATISTICS.AuthenticationId LUID uint64, ProcessIdToSessionId. Python verifies server image file ID and SHA256 against the fixed installed artifact/manifest. Rust accepts same credentials Python client; CLI stop additionally requires exact observer image file ID.
